blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language-guided 3D affordance grounding aims to localize functional regions on 3D objects according to interaction intents. However, existing methods exhibit poor generalization to unseen objects. One challenge is the query-target gap: a semantic discrepancy between query features encoding interaction intents and target-region features, leading to inaccurate grounding. End-to-end training favors query representations tailored to seen objects, limiting their compatibility with shifted target-region features on unseen objects. To address this issue, we propose BridgeAfford, a framework that reduces the query-target semantic gap from two complementary perspectives. First, Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) promotes cross-object alignment among geometrically similar interaction regions during training. This enables structures on unseen objects that resemble previously observed ones to produce representations similar to those learned during training, facilitating target-region recognition. Second, Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA) leverages a 2D affordance model to refine the attention distribution and guide the query toward the correct region, yielding more target-aware queries. Extensive experiments on the LASO and PIAD datasets demonstrate that BridgeAfford outperforms existing methods, particularly on unseen objects, highlighting its robust generalization ability.
blocks.zh: 语言导取的3D平价地基旨在根据交互意图将功能区域定位于3D对象上. 然而,现有方法对看不见物体的概括性很差。 一个挑战是查询-目标差距:查询特征编码互动意图与目标区域特征之间的语义差异,导致不准确的地基. 端到端训练偏好针对所见对象的查询表达式,限制其与所见对象上变化的目标区域特征相容. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议BridgeAfford,从两个互补的角度缩小查询-目标语义差距的框架。 第一,在培训期间,相互作用区域对接(IRA)促进几何相似相互作用区域之间的交叉对象对接。 这使得与以前观测到的物体相类似的看不见物体上的结构能够产生与培训期间学到的物体相类似的表述,促进目标区域识别。 第二,视觉证据聚合(VEA)利用2D提供模式来完善注意力分布并引导查询向正确的区域,从而产生更多的目标意识查询。 关于LASO和PIAD数据集的广泛实验表明,BridgeAfford比现有方法,特别是在看不见的物体上,表现优于现有方法,突出了其强大的通缩能力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize functional regions on 3D objects according to interaction intents, which is fundamental for embodied agents. Recently, language-guided 3D affordance grounding has attracted increasing attention, as natural-language instructions can express more flexible and fine-grained interaction intents than predefined affordance labels ( Li et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 3D承受力地基旨在根据相互作用的意向,将功能区域定位于3D对象上,这对所体现物剂来说是根本的. 最近,语言导取的3D负担地平线引起了越来越多的关注,因为自然语言指令可以比预定义的支付地平线标签(Li等,2024年)表达出更灵活和精细的相互作用意图.

blocks.en: However, existing methods still suffer from limited generalization, with substantial performance degradation on objects unseen during training. Most prior approaches ( Li et al., 2024 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) follow a common LASO paradigm: given an instruction and a point cloud, the model uses the interaction intent to extract target-region information from point-wise object features and incorporate it into query features, aligning them semantically with the target region. The affordance mask is subsequently predicted by measuring the similarity between the target-aware queries and the point-wise object features.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有方法仍然受到有限普遍化的影响,培训期间未见物体的性能严重退化。 大多数先前的方法(Li等,2024;Lu等,2025;Li等,2025)遵循了共同的LASO范式:给出了指令和点云,模型使用交互意图从点向对象特征中提取出目标区域信息并将其纳入查询特征,使其与目标区域相适应. 随后通过测量目标知觉查询与点心对象特征的相似性来预测出负担面罩.

blocks.en: For objects seen during training, the model can learn and memorize the correspondence between interaction intents and target regions, incorporating the correct regional features into the query to achieve semantic alignment with the target region. On unseen objects at inference time, however, it may encounter interaction-region representations that deviate from those observed during training. As a result, it cannot reliably use learned associations to incorporate the relevant information into the query, leading to a semantic gap with the target region.
blocks.zh: 对于在训练中看到的物体,该模型可以学习并记住互动意图与目标区域之间的对应关系,将正确的区域特征纳入查询中,以达到与目标区域的语义一致. 然而,在推断时间的看不见物体上,它可能会遇到不同于训练期间观察到的相互作用区域表述。 因此,它无法可靠地利用所学的协会将相关信息纳入查询,导致与目标区域的语义差距.

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Motivation for BridgeAfford.
(a) Accurate prediction relies on high semantic similarity between the query and the target-region representation. However, shifted local representations on unseen objects may prevent the model from extracting the target region, resulting in query features with low similarity to it.
(b) Unseen objects may contain interaction regions that are geometrically similar to those of seen objects. Aligning these regions with geometrically similar regions on training objects promotes consistent representations, helping the model recognize interaction regions and incorporate their semantic information into the query.
(c) Objects may contain novel interaction structures that cannot be reliably aligned with those observed during training based on geometric similarity. We therefore use a more generalizable 2D affordance model to directly guide feature extraction, facilitating the generation of target-aware queries.

blocks.en: Based on this observation, we aim to narrow the semantic gap between queries and target regions. Specifically, we enable the model to reliably capture target-region features and incorporate them into queries, even on unseen objects. First, we encourage geometrically similar interaction regions across training objects to have consistent representations. This allows similar structures on unseen objects to retain familiar feature patterns, making them easier for the model to recognize. Second, novel interaction structures may not be reliably associated with those observed during training through geometric similarity alone. We therefore integrate spatial evidence from a generalizable 2D affordance model to directly guide target-region feature extraction and facilitate the formation of target-aware queries.
blocks.zh: 基于这一看法,我们的目标是缩小查询与目标区域之间的语义差距。 具体地说,我们使模型能够可靠地捕捉目标区域特征,并将其纳入查询中,甚至在看不见的物体上也是如此。 第一,我们鼓励各个训练对象的几何互动区域保持一贯的表述。 这使得在看不见的物体上类似的结构可以保留出熟悉的特征图案,使模型更容易识别出. 第二,仅通过几何相似性,新式互动结构可能无法可靠地与在培训期间观察到的结构联系起来。 因此,我们从通用的2D承受力模型中整合空间证据,直接指导目标区域地物提取,并便利形成目标意识查询。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose BridgeAfford, which narrows the query–target gap through Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) and Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA). IRA encourages consistent representations of recurring local interaction structures across objects. We first use Diversity-Aware Initialization (DAI) to construct a compact set of geometrically diverse anchors in a Category-Agnostic Interaction Memory (CAIM). During training, Affinity-Based Contrastive Learning (ABCL) aligns interaction regions with these anchors according to geometric similarity. This encourages the model to represent similar interaction structures consistently despite differences in the objects containing them. When such structures appear on unseen objects, their interaction-region features remain close to those of geometrically similar local structures observed during training.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们建议BridgeAfford,通过交互区域对齐(IRA)和视觉证据聚合(VEA)缩小查询-目标差距。 共和军鼓励始终如一地表达不同对象之间反复出现的当地互动结构。 我们首先使用多样性-意识初始化(DAI)在一类不可知相互作用记忆(CAIM)中构建一套紧凑的几何多样性锚地. 在培训期间,基于无限的对比性学习(ABCL)根据几何相似性使互动区域与这些主锚相配合. 这鼓励该模型始终如一地代表类似的相互作用结构,尽管其中的物体有所不同。 当这些结构出现在看不见的物体上时,它们的相互作用区域特征仍然接近训练期间观察到的几何相近的地方结构。

blocks.en: Complementing this region alignment, VEA provides spatial guidance for target-region feature extraction on the current object. We employ a Normal-Based Gaussian Renderer (NBGR) to generate multi-view renderings and a lightweight 2D affordance model to localize target regions in each view. Confidence-Aware Multi-View Aggregation (CAMVA) then lifts these predictions into dense point-wise 3D visual evidence. We incorporate this evidence as a bias in text-to-point cross-attention, guiding feature extraction toward the target region and yielding more reliable, target-aware queries.
blocks.zh: 作为这一区域协调的补充,VEA为当前物体上的目标区域地物提取提供了空间指导. 我们使用一个基于常态的高斯渲染器(NBGR)来生成多视图渲染和一种轻量级的2D支付模型来使每个视图中的目标区域本地化. 置信-Aware多维聚合(CAMVA)后将这些预测提升为密集的点智3D视觉证据. 我们把这种证据作为偏差纳入文字对点的交叉注意,指导向目标区域提取特征,并产生更可靠、更了解目标的询问。

blocks.en: We validate BridgeAfford on the LASO and PIAD datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves leading performance, particularly on unseen categories.
blocks.zh: 我们在LASO和PIAD数据集上验证 BridgeAfford. 实验结果表明,我们的模型取得了领先业绩,特别是在无形类别方面。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We propose BridgeAfford, a framework that narrows the query–target gap by enabling more reliable target-region feature extraction on unseen objects. • We introduce Interaction Region Alignment (IRA) to promote consistent representations of geometrically similar interaction regions across objects, providing transferable cues for target recognition. Complementarily, Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA) converts multi-view 2D predictions into dense spatial evidence to guide target-region feature extraction and produce target-aware queries. • Extensive experiments on LASO and PIAD demonstrate that BridgeAfford outperforms existing methods, particularly in unseen settings, validating its strong generalization ability.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 3D affordance learning localizes functional regions on 3D objects. Early work formulates it as point-wise multi-label segmentation ( Deng et al., 2021 ) , while later methods represent interaction intent using human-object interaction images ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Shao et al., 2025 ) or language. For language-based grounding, OpenAD ( Nguyen et al., 2023 ) enables open-vocabulary affordance detection with pretrained text encoders, and LASO ( Li et al., 2024 ) extends the input to sentence-level instructions. Recent methods ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Chu et al., 2025 ; Basak and Yin, 2025 ) improve this setting with external models, cross-modal designs, or enhanced training strategies, yet generalization to unseen objects remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 3D平价学习在3D对象上将功能区域本地化. 早期工作将其形成为指向点的多标签分解(Deng等,2021年),而后期方法则代表了使用人-物体相互作用图像的相互作用意图(Yang等,2023年;Shao等,2025年)或语言. 对于基于语言的地平线,OpenAD(Nguyen等,2023年)可以使用被预先训练的文本编码器进行开放-vocabulary支付检测,而LASO(Li等,2024年)将输入扩展为句级指令. 最近的方法(Lu等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年;Chu等人,2025年;Basak和Yin,2025年)通过外部模型、跨模式设计或强化培训战略改进了这种环境,然而,对隐形物体的概括仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: LASO ( Li et al., 2024 ) integrates textual and geometric features through multi-layer upsampling, while GEAL ( Lu et al., 2025 ) improves robustness with 2D–3D consistency alignment. GLANCE ( Li et al., 2025 ) introduces cross-modal connectors between the 3D and text encoders, and CMAT ( Huang et al., 2026 ) transfers knowledge from 2D foundation models via cross-modal affinity consistency. Overall, these methods enhance object features by injecting semantic information from 2D or text encoders. Additionally, Aff3DFunc ( Wu et al., 2025 ) utilizes contrastive learning to associate point cloud features with functional semantics. Gou and He (2026) employ a set of prototypes to align features corresponding to the same affordance. These methods typically rely on explicit labels to align or distinguish local features. However, in language-guided tasks, interaction intents are implicitly expressed by sentences, making explicit labels unavailable. Extracting such labels with LLMs is costly and does not resolve a deeper issue: the same intent may correspond to geometrically diverse regions across objects, and forcibly aligning them can distort object representations. In contrast to prior works, our method does not rely on explicit affordance labels. Instead, it identifies interaction regions with similar geometric patterns across objects and enforces consistent representations over these regions.
blocks.zh: LASO(Li等,2024年)通过多层上下采样整合了文字和几何特征,而GEAL(Lu等,2025年)则以2D–3D一致性对接来提高稳健性. GLANCE(Li等,2025年)在3D和文本编码器之间引入了跨模式连接器,而CMAT(Huang等,2026年)通过跨模式亲和一致性从2D基础模型中传输知识. 总体而言,这些方法通过从2D或文本编码器中注入语义信息来增强对象特征. 此外,Aff3DFunc(Wu等人,2025年)利用对比性学习将云点特征与功能语义联系起来。 Gou和He (2026)使用一套原型,以对接对应同一付价的特性. 这些方法通常依靠明确的标签来对齐或区分本地特征. 然而,在语言引导的任务中,互动意向被句子所暗示,使得没有明确的标签无法使用. 用LLMS取出这种标签成本很高,不会解决更深层的问题:同样的意图可能与不同物体的几何区域相适应,强行调整它们会扭曲物体的表示. 与之前的作品相比,我们的方法并不依赖于明确的支付标签. 相反,它确定了具有类似几何特征的相互作用区域,并在这些区域实施一致的表述。

blocks.en:
Recent studies have explored different ways to enhance target-aware query representations.
PART ( Gou and He, 2026 ) and HAMMER ( Yao et al., 2026 ) rely on LLMs or MLLMs to infer interaction-related semantics.
However, such high-level and abstract semantic priors still remain semantically distant from features of the target region, while also introducing considerable computational overhead.
In contrast, we employ a lightweight DINOv2-based 2D affordance model to directly predict target-region masks on rendered views and lift them into 3D, providing more explicit spatial guidance.
GLANCE ( Li et al., 2025 ) further introduces 2D visual cues through sparse keypoint sampling.
However, sparse samples capture only partial evidence from the target mask and discard its continuous spatial structure and intra-region confidence variation.
Our CAMVA instead produces dense and smooth point-wise guidance over the entire target region, enabling the query to aggregate more comprehensive regional features while preserving stronger responses at more confident points.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究探索了加强目标意识查询表述的不同方式.
Part (Gou and He, 2026)和HAMMER (Yao等, 2026)依靠LLMs或MLLMs推导出与交互相关的语义.
然而,这种高层次和抽象的语义学前科仍然与目标区域的特点相去甚远,同时也引入了相当大的计算间接费用。
相比之下,我们使用一种轻量级的DINOv2-基于2D的平价模型来直接预测在所显示的视图上的目标区域口罩,并把它们提升到3D,提供更明确的空间指导.
GLANCE(Li等,2025年)通过稀疏的键点取样进一步引入了2D可视提示.
然而,稀有的样本只从目标口罩取出部分证据并丢弃其持续的空间结构和区域内的信心变化.
反之,我们的CAMVA对整个目标区域提供了密集而平滑的点入指导,使查询能够汇总更全面的区域特征,同时在更有信心的点保持更强有力的反应。

blocks.en: 3.2 Interaction Region Alignment

blocks.en: During training, we extract two region-level features from the annotated interaction region for each sample: a geometric region feature 𝐠 r \mathbf{g}^{r} and a language-aware region feature 𝐟 r \mathbf{f}^{r} . We obtain 𝐠 r \mathbf{g}^{r} and 𝐟 r \mathbf{f}^{r} by masked average pooling: 𝐠 r = Norm ⁡ ( ∑ i = 1 R y i g ​ 𝐠 i ∑ i = 1 R y i g + ϵ ) , 𝐟 r = Norm ⁡ ( ∑ i = 1 N y i ​ 𝐟 i ∑ i = 1 N y i + ϵ ) . \mathbf{g}^{r}=\operatorname{Norm}\left(\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{R}y^{g}_{i}\mathbf{g}_{i}}{\sum_{i=1}^{R}y^{g}_{i}+\epsilon}\right),\quad\mathbf{f}^{r}=\operatorname{Norm}\left(\frac{\sum_{i=1}^{N}y_{i}\mathbf{f}_{i}}{\sum_{i=1}^{N}y_{i}+\epsilon}\right). blocks.en: 3.3 Visual Evidence Aggregation
blocks.zh: 3.3 视觉证据综合

blocks.en: Geometric alignment may provide insufficient cues for unseen objects with novel or substantially shifted local structures, causing the model to attend to incorrect or incomplete target regions. We therefore introduce Visual Evidence Aggregation (VEA), which converts multi-view 2D affordance predictions into dense 3D visual evidence to guide target-region feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 几何校正可能为有新颖或地方结构被大幅改变的看不见物体提供不足的提示,使模型能够处理不正确或不完整的目标区域。 因此,我们引入了视觉证据聚合(VEA),将多视图2D承受率预测转换成密集的3D视觉证据来指导目标区域地物提取.

blocks.en: Renderers such as Mitsuba 3 provide high-quality visualization but are relatively heavy for repeatedly generating multi-view renderings. Following GEAL ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , we adopt Gaussian rendering for efficient multi-view point-cloud rendering. To enrich visual cues for colorless point clouds, we further estimate point normals from local neighborhoods and convert them into RGB colors. This normal-based coloring produces rendered images with clearer surface orientation, object parts, and geometric structures.
blocks.zh: Mitsuba 3等渲染器提供高品质的可视化,但对于反复生成多视图渲染器来说相对重. 在GEAL(Lu等,2025年)之后,我们采用高斯渲染来高效地进行多视点-云渲染. 为了丰富无色点云的视觉提示,我们进一步估算出来自当地邻居的点平平并转换为RGB颜色. 这种以平面为主的取色产生更清晰地表面取向,物体部件和几何结构的成像.

blocks.en: The 2D affordance model is first trained with view-level supervision rendered from 3D point-wise annotations following GEAL ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , and then frozen to produce multi-view affordance heatmaps for VEA. For the 3D model, we optimize the point-wise affordance prediction loss together with the CAIM alignment objective: ℒ = ℒ seg + λ caim ​ ℒ caim . \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{seg}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{caim}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{caim}}. The CAIM loss encourages geometrically similar interaction regions to share a unified and generalized representation.

blocks.en: Training the 3D backbone proceeds in three stages. First, we train the backbone using only ℒ seg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{seg}} , so that the text-geometry fusion module and upsampler learn relatively stable object representations. Second, we initialize CAIM with the Diversity-Aware Initialization described above. Third, we jointly optimize ℒ seg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{seg}} and ℒ caim \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{caim}} while updating the CAIM online with EMA. During inference, CAIM is omitted, and BridgeAfford operates with only VEA and the 3D backbone.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: BridgeAfford improves 3D affordance grounding on unseen objects by narrowing the semantic gap between queries and target regions. Our results suggest that transferable local geometric structures learned from similar interaction regions contribute to cross-object generalization, while 2D visual evidence provides valuable guidance for query localization. Extensive experiments on LASO and PIAD validate the superiority of BridgeAfford, highlighting the potential of combining geometric structures with 2D visual priors for generalizable 3D affordance understanding.
blocks.zh: BridgeAfford通过缩小查询和目标区域之间的语义差距,改进了3D承受力在隐形物体上的基础. 我们的结果表明,从类似相互作用区域中吸取的可转移的局部几何结构有助于交叉对象通论,而2D视觉证据为查询本地化提供了宝贵的指导. 关于LASO和PIAD的广泛实验验证了BridgeAfford的优越性,凸显了将几何结构与2D视觉前身结合的可能性,以通俗化的3D承受力理解.

blocks.en: Appendix B Quantitative Analysis of the Query–Target Gap
blocks.zh: 附录B 查询-目标差距分析

blocks.en: In this section, we quantify the query–target gap and examine the effects of individual modules from this perspective. As shown in Table 8 , we measure the similarity between queries and target-region features under four configurations. Specifically, we first compute a target-region representation by averaging point-wise features weighted by the ground-truth affordance scores. We then calculate the cosine similarity between each query feature and this pooled representation and average the similarities across queries to obtain the query–target similarity. For comparison, we also measure the similarity between queries and non-target-region features. The results show that both IRA and VEA improve query–target similarity, with their combination achieving the highest target-region similarity.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们将查询-目标差距量化,并从这一角度审查各个模块的效果。 如表8所示,我们在四个配置下衡量查询与目标区域特征之间的相似性。 具体地说,我们首先通过平均点到点的特征来计算一个目标区域的代表性,这些特征以地面真实承受能力得分加权。 然后,我们计算每个查询特征与这种集合代表的同位素相似性,并平均各种查询的相似性,以获得查询-目标相似性。 为了进行比较,我们还衡量了询问和非目标区域特征之间的相似性。 结果显示,IRA和VEA都改进了查询-目标相似性,它们的组合实现了最高目标-地区相似性.

blocks.en: D.2 Generalization Capability of the 2D Affordance Model versus the 3D Backbone

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 4.3 , directly adopting aggregated 2D masks as the final output for 3D affordance grounding leads to performance degradation. However, this does not necessarily indicate weaker generalization of 2D models. To investigate this, we project the predictions of the pure 3D backbone onto the image plane and compare them with the 2D affordance predictions. Since the projection shares the same rendering process used for data generation, the projection error is negligible, enabling a fair comparison between 2D and 3D models. As shown in Table 9 , the 2D affordance model achieves better performance, highlighting its strong generalization ability and effectiveness as a visual prior for 3D affordance grounding.
blocks.zh: 如第4.3节所讨论,直接采用总的2D口罩作为3D承受力打地的最后产出,导致性能退化。 然而,这并不一定表明2D模型的概括性较弱. 为了调查这一点,我们把纯三维主干线的预测投放到图像平面上,并与2D支付率预测进行比较. 由于投影共用了用于数据生成的同一种渲染过程,因此投影出错是可忽略不计的,使得2D和3D模型能够进行公平的比较. 如表9所示,2D支付模式能实现更好的性能,突出显示其强大的通缩能力和有效性,作为3D支付地基之前的视觉.

blocks.en: D.3 Dense Point-wise Evidence vs. Sparse Keypoint Sampling
blocks.zh: D.3 尖端证据对 Sparse 关键点抽样

blocks.en: In this section, we compare the sparse keypoint sampling strategy introduced by GLANCE with our CAMVA to investigate how different visual guidance strategies convert multi-view 2D affordance masks into effective 3D guidance. For a fair comparison, both variants use the same 3D backbone, 2D affordance model, multi-view predictions, and training settings, differing only in how the 2D visual evidence is aggregated and incorporated into the 3D model. The GLANCE-style strategy selects a sparse set of reliable 3D keypoints from the multi-view masks as query priors, whereas CAMVA performs confidence-weighted multi-view aggregation based on projection validity and depth consistency, producing dense point-wise visual evidence that is incorporated as a cross-attention bias.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们比较了GLANCE推出的稀缺关键点采样策略与我们的CAMVA,以调查不同的视觉指导策略如何将多视图2D支付口罩转化为有效的3D指导. 为了进行公平的比较,两个变体都使用相同的3D主干,2D支付模式,多视图预测,以及训练设置,仅在2D视觉证据如何被汇总并被收录到3D模型中时不同. GLANCE式策略从多视图口罩中选择了一组稀有的可靠3D键位作为查询前缀,而CAMVA则根据投影有效性和深度一致性进行置信加权多视图汇总,产生密集的点入点的可视性证据,作为交叉入点偏差被收录.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 10 , CAMVA consistently outperforms the sparse keypoint strategy across all metrics. These results indicate that preserving and aggregating dense point-wise confidence information provides more effective spatial guidance for target-region feature aggregation than representing the multi-view masks with a sparse set of keypoints.
blocks.zh: 如表10所显示的,CAMVA在所有衡量标准上的业绩始终高于稀少的关键点战略。 这些结果表明,保存和汇总密集的点心置信信息,比用稀有的关键点代表多视图口罩,为目标区域特征汇总提供了更有效的空间指导。

blocks.en: Table 11 indicates that wrap-grasping remains challenging, particularly for mugs, bowls, and bottles. One possible factor is ambiguity in the ground-truth annotations: multiple contact configurations can be physically plausible, while the annotated affordance map may capture only some of them. Consequently, a reasonable prediction may still differ from the reference in its location or coverage. Moreover, wrap-grasping involves an extended contact surface rather than a localized functional part, making it difficult to accurately match both the spatial extent and the point-wise score distribution. This is reflected in bowl-wrap-grasp and bottle-wrap-grasp, where relatively high SIM scores (0.745 and 0.703) coexist with low aIoU scores (4.50 and 7.09), suggesting partial distributional agreement without precise spatial overlap. Limited visibility across rendered views may further leave parts of these surrounding contact surfaces insufficiently supported by visual evidence. These cases suggest room for improving spatial coverage and handling ambiguity in interaction regions.
blocks.zh: 表11显示,包装草仍然具有挑战性,特别是在杯子、碗和瓶子方面。 一个可能的因素就是地面真实说明中的模糊性:多重接触配置在物理上是可行的,而附加说明的支付地图可能只捕捉其中的一些。 因此,合理的预测可能仍然不同于其所在地或覆盖范围中的参考。 此外,包装草涉及一个延伸的接触面,而不是局部的功能部分,因此难以准确匹配空间范围与分数分布. 这体现在碗-围-接-接-接-接-接-接-接-接-接-接-接-接-接,相对较高的SIM分数(0.745分和0.703分)与低AIOU分数(4.50分和7.09分)并存,表明部分分配协议没有精确的空间重叠. 各种观点的能见度有限,可能进一步使这些周围接触的表面缺乏视觉证据的支持。 这些情况表明,在互动区域,空间覆盖面和处理模糊性方面仍有改进的余地。
